heading: Tailor-made travel
intro: Tell us where you would like to go and how you like to travel. Your advisor then chooses the hotels, sightseeing, cruises and private guides, and arranges the flights, transfers and visas around them. The pace is yours to set.

sections.heading: How a tailor-made trip comes together
paragraphs: A package holiday is the same trip for everyone who books it. A tailor-made one starts with a conversation, and is built for you by advisors who have travelled widely and still travel regularly.
The ideas on this site and in our brochures are where that conversation can begin. None of them is fixed.
After that, the trip follows what you tell us. You might want rest, or adventure, or some of each, and there may be one region you have always meant to see, or something you have never tried.

sections.heading: Why plan it this way?
paragraphs: Because a holiday works best when it fits you. We find out what you like and what you don't, and the itinerary is planned around the answers.
Your advisor is still there after you book. Up to the day you leave, and while you are away, they answer your questions and make changes if your plans shift.
